scriptText: 補給路を奪うだけでは真実は残らない。護衛も運び手も生きたまま話を聞く必要がある。 命令は紙一枚だ。だが戦場の命は、一枚では数え切れん。
qaCaveats: Gray-haired veteran points out the supply route in the unlettered map to silver-haired Lucia. Not formal P0 certified.
notes: Owner-authorized visual placeholder; P0 uniform/hair continuity and human approval NOT claimed. Correct script is displayed by game UI, not burned in image. Existing game art reversible.
